notes.title: Gravity Fix and Pricing
notes.content: Fixed gravity in Level 1 and 2 on fps controller and the price of First Response will be raised to 9.99 but that'll be the only time it gets raised.

notes.title: Controller Support and QoL Patch Update
notes.content:
Hi! So this update has a number of new things tweaked from art assets, bug fixes, controller support finally and a skip button to move through scenes faster. Also after reaching the credits, you will unlock a scene select option on the main menu. 

1. Main Menu redesign -- The main menu was reworked as the original one was super ugly and disorganized as well as new options like the Controller Support Toggle and full screen is now a toggle as well. 

2. Controller Support -- While the mouse and keyboard options still use the Unity FPS Controller as a starting point with things bolted on, the controller support option is a  movement built from the ground up. I didn't add footsteps to it but I might do that in a future update if there's interest. Also I didn't add anything to the GUI Prompts below I have controls listed

X (Xbox) / Square (Playstation) -- Works for the E Interact Key

Click Left Stick -- Works for the C Crouch Key

RT (Xbox) / R2 (Playstation) -- Left Click to Shoot (Spoilers When you get there...)

LT (Xbox) / L2 (Playstation) -- Z to Zoom

B (Xbox) / Circle (Playstation) -- Skip Dialogue with R Key (Note: During the scene transitions, you still may be subjected to brief loads)

Also included are in game FOV sliders, Horizontal and Vertical Sliders for the Right Stick Control on the Mouse.

This only applies to the 3D sections though, as the Simulator sections still use mouse and keyboard only but it's modeled after a computer anyway and you are certainly playing it on a computer with Mouse and Keyboard. Though, I might update it to work with controller if there is interest. Never say never

3. Texture Changes -- Like K.A.R.A.'s new design and in the Chapter 6 section where you play as Emma, her design on her ID Card has been redone as well as small things here and there.

4. Bug Fixes and Performance Tweaks where it could be done though it isn't perfect just yet (But bear with me, only one working on this and it's a large game).
